title: Track Guide Oulton Park Fosters BMW M2 Rookie Fixed iRacing

corners.spoken_as: the banner here on the left
corners.braking: Brake at the banner, 50% pressure, trail brake to inside curb
corners.line: Take all of the inside curb
corners.mistakes: Going over outside curb can slow the car

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Lift off at dip, hold a few% brake pressure
corners.line: Take all of the inside curb
corners.exit: Come out at most at the middle of the track

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: 70% brake pressure, trail brake to inside curb
corners.exit: Ease in throttle, avoid outside curb
corners.mistakes: Hitting anti-cut can un-silt the car, touching outside curb causes wheel spin

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: Brake at the tree, 50% pressure, ease off until first curb
corners.line: Get close to both curbs, double apex
corners.exit: Slowly accelerate after first curb, full throttle on hitting second curb
corners.mistakes: Steer off second curb if accelerating too hard

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: Break after track dip, 70% pressure, ease off until emergency road
corners.exit: Ease in throttle after emergency road, use curbing for exit speed
corners.mistakes: Run off road if accelerating too hard, avoid grass

general_tips: Be as smooth as possible and shorten the distance where we can
